entries.prompt: Production pixel-art game asset, using attached approved Sky pirates concept as design reference. Redraw the SAME whimsical cream/sage/coral patched balloon and wooden pirate gondola as a clean TRANSPARENT stage plate, no scenery, no clouds, no whales, no people, no text, no badges. TRUE crisp low-resolution pixel art, intended native 480x320 logical pixels, limited palette about 48 colours, no soft antialiasing. 3:2 landscape composition. Entire level SIDE-ON BROADSIDE ship, bow left, raised stern right; absolutely horizontal deck/keel. Small top-down view of usable deck like reference. Scale/layout as logical coordinates: ship hull x45..435, top deck y207..238, flat lower hull edge y279; raised stern deck x355..421 y192..212 with wheel. Squash balloon: x85..393 y64..137 (wide flattened oval, NOT tall), brass bands and patches matching reference; top lookout basket x233..261 y46..64, flag pole and sage pennant above, with rope ladder down near balloon front to deck at x246 y223. Two stubby cream sails x48..99 y130..183 and x383..430 y130..183. Thin suspension ropes connect balloon to rail. Open wide deck, wooden hatch x144..168 y222, small brass crank engine with firebox x266..295 y207..233, four rail lanterns. Brass propeller at far right x432..469 y223..260. Bird figurehead on LEFT bow and a short separate left-pointing bowsprit x17..72 y218. A narrow departure plank comes FORWARD toward viewer at x102..120 from deck y236 down to y267, leaving the left cloud pocket clear for the falling sailor. Hull lower face must be continuous warm wood with dark blue straps; leave it WITHOUT portholes (sleeping-window sprites will overlay it). No windows baked in. No steam or glow haze baked in. Keep deck path broad and uncluttered for 24 small sailors. Match approved concept charm and quality but simplify detail to legible native pixel clusters. Transparent background is mandatory.

Production pixel-art CREW SPRITE SHEET for the attached approved Sky pirates scene (reference for character style only). Transparent background. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equally spaced cells, one complete sailor in each cell, generous transparent gaps, no grid lines, no labels or text. Same small charming sailor in WHITE SAILOR CAP with dark band, navy blue jacket, cream shirt, tan trousers, brown shoes, warm face. Simple readable native pixel art, each figure intended about 18x30 game pixels, enlarged crisp square clusters; not detailed illustration. Same proportions and consistent foot baseline within every cell. Rows read left to right:
Row 1: front standing; front walking left foot forward; front passing feet; front walking right foot forward.
Row 2: right-facing profile idle; right-facing walking left foot forward; right-facing passing feet; right-facing walking right foot forward.
Row 3: right-facing cranking engine with hands high forward; right-facing cranking with hands low forward; front waiting hand on hip; front relaxed seated sleepy sailor.
Row 4: rear-facing rope-ladder climbing left arm up and right knee up; rear-facing climbing right arm up and left knee up; right-facing lookout holding brass telescope to eye; front startled falling with arms up.
No ladder or engine in sheet: poses only, no props except telescope, no scenery, no shadows. White caps must remain visible in every pose. All 16 figures complete and distinct, aligned on regular 4x4 layout.

Production game background for the attached Sky pirates concept, reference STYLE AND ENVIRONMENT only. No foreground ship, no balloon, no sailors, no whale, no text. Crisp native PIXEL ART, deliberately simple coherent square pixel clusters and limited palette, intended 600x400 game background. Wide 3:2 landscape. Daylight blue sky with pink-gold distant horizon at two-thirds height. A SMALL floating grass island and warm miniature village at far LEFT edge, and a SMALL floating island with mountain peak at far RIGHT edge. Centre 70 percent of image is empty clear blue sky to keep foreground balloon/deck readable. Lower third is an uninterrupted fluffy sea of ivory/pale peach/periwinkle clouds. No water, no waterfalls (islands have dry rocky roots), no birds or airships baked in, no individual sky clouds baked in (animated clouds added separately). Storybook charm, gentle clean light, layered distant haze, no smooth gradients or photographic texture. Designed to sit behind a level broadside pirate airship.

Edit the attached production pixel-art sky background into its NIGHT phase. Preserve exact island outlines, positions, mountain shapes, cloud contours and framing. No ship or people. Deep indigo sky, lavender-blue cloud sea, silver moonlight edges, warm tiny windows in the distant village. Add a large softly cratered pale full moon in the open upper right sky above the mountain (not hidden by island), and small crisp sparse stars. Same native pixel-art style, limited 64-colour palette, clear stepped pixel clusters, no blur. Keep all geography registered to the day image. 3:2 landscape.

Production pixel art ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, transparent background, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows, twelve equally sized cells with generous transparent gaps, no lines no captions. Matching attached approved whimsical Sky pirates whale design. Crisp simple native game pixels, flat limited shades, no blur or gradients.
ROW ONE: four animation frames of SMALL friendly slate-blue whale facing right, cream pleated throat, kind eye, mouth closed, swimming/flippers changing subtly. In EACH frame whale lower half is concealed INSIDE a scalloped ivory/lavender cloud-bank fringe crossing the middle of body. No gap beneath whale. Same whale body size and position in each cell. A small white speech bubble with three dark square dots sits above whale in all four cells. Designed to become a 56x44 pixel clickable companion.
ROW TWO: four LARGE departure whale animation poses, same slate-blue whale and cream throat, no speech bubble. First: domed back and fin just emerging from a low cloud puff. Second: whale rises halfway, mouth starting to open UPWARDS. Third: full breach with mouth wide OPEN UPWARD to swallow a falling sailor (NO sailor drawn), large soft rounded lips, no teeth. Fourth: mouth closed, whale settling into cloud puff. Same registration, base cloud line and width across cells. Entire whale fits each cell; lower body hidden in cloud fringe. Designed 100x80 logical pixels each.
ROW THREE: four CLOUD PUFF explosion animation frames: small compact cream-lavender puff, expanding ring of fluffy cloud wisps, larger dissipating puff ring, sparse final wisps. No water, no whale, no other objects in this row.
Keep all twelve subjects separate, centred, equal cell grid. Match concept charm. No text except three-dot markers in first row.

A production PIXEL ART atlas for approved whimsical Sky pirates game scene. Exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE independent sprites centred in equally sized cells with wide transparent gaps. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no glow haze, no grid lines, captions or text. Crisp simple native-scale pixel clusters, dark navy outlines on objects, limited palettes. Matching the attached scene's cream/sage/coral, brass, periwinkle clouds and white sailor caps.
Row 1 left-to-right: (1) wide fluffy ivory cloud bank with lavender-blue shadow underside, (2) smaller round ivory cloud puff, (3) long thin horizontal mist wisp, (4) a curling plume of pale grey chimney steam, expanding upwards.
Row 2 left-to-right: (1) white gull facing right wings up, (2) same white gull facing right wings down, (3) tiny distant cream/sage patched balloon airship with warm wooden gondola side-on, (4) circular brass-rimmed dark wooden porthole with a sleeping white-capped sailor tucked in a navy hammock, eye closed, NO z or text.
Row 3 left-to-right: FOUR animation poses of same elegant turquoise blue SKY SERPENT, long coiling body with cream underside and small amber eye, emerging between lavender cloud tufts. Pose 1 coils low with head peeking; pose 2 head rises and S bends; pose 3 head turns and tail curls; pose 4 returns low. All whole serpent silhouettes fit inside their cells, same scale and framing; no scary teeth or fire.
Each cell contains only its requested item. Transparent gaps must separate all 12 sprites.

Production pixel art weather FX sheet for whimsical sky pirate game. Transparent background, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four separate assets with broad transparent gaps. No text or grid. Limited pixel palette, crisp chunky pixels intended native game scale.
Top left: long wide ominous purple/slate thunderhead cloud bank, scalloped upper edge, dark underside, no lightning.
Top right: branching pale lavender-white lightning bolt descending vertically, split branches, entire bolt fits cell, no glow haze.
Bottom left: second distinct branching lightning bolt, similar width and length, offset branches, crisp white and pale blue pixels.
Bottom right: sparse diagonal silver-blue RAIN streaks spread evenly across a rectangular tile area, transparent between the rain drops, no other objects. Each rain streak only a few logical pixels long, varied spaced dashes.
Style matches attached sky pirates scene; atmospheric and storybook, not realistic.
